knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r setup and libs}
library(here)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```


```{r}
dir.create(here("figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
count_files <- list.files(path = here("data", "GSE188644"), pattern = "counts_gene.txt.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
count_files
all_data <- lapply(count_files, function(f) {
  read.delim(f, header = TRUE)
})
# confirming if every file has genes in the same order before assuming a plain cbind is safe
gene_symbols <- lapply(all_data, function(df) df$Symbol)
stopifnot(all(sapply(gene_symbols, identical, gene_symbols[[1]])))
```


```{r}
# Build the raw counts matrix (there are duplicates present at this point) 
raw_counts <- sapply(all_data, function(df) df$Count)
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("_RNA_Seq.*", "", basename(count_files))
rownames(raw_counts) <- NULL  # deliberately no rownames yet to avoid the auto-uniquify
symbols <- gene_symbols[[1]]  # original symbols, kept separately
cat(sprintf("Raw matrix: %d gene rows (%d unique symbols, %d duplicated)\n",
            nrow(raw_counts), length(unique(symbols)), sum(duplicated(symbols))))
 
# --- Collapse duplicate symbols by summing, using the ORIGINAL symbol vector ---
counts_collapsed <- rowsum(raw_counts, group = symbols)
 
cat(sprintf("Collapsed matrix: %d unique gene rows\n", nrow(counts_collapsed)))
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(rownames(counts_collapsed))) == 0)
 
# sanity check UBE2H survived and looks reasonable
counts_collapsed["UBE2H", ]
```


```{r}
# Build sample metadata directly from the (already clean) column names
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(counts_collapsed),
  LMB2OE = ifelse(grepl("LMB2OE", colnames(counts_collapsed)), "OE", "Control"),
  treatment = ifelse(grepl("Reversine", colnames(counts_collapsed)), "Reversine", "DMSO")
)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample
sample_info$treatment <- factor(sample_info$treatment, levels = c("DMSO", "Reversine"))
sample_info$LMB2OE <- factor(sample_info$LMB2OE, levels = c("Control", "OE"))
 
print(sample_info)
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_collapsed) == rownames(sample_info)))
```
```{r}
# Keeping only LMB2OE == "Control" samples
non_oe_samples <- rownames(sample_info)[sample_info$LMB2OE == "Control"]

counts_non_oe <- counts_collapsed[, non_oe_samples]
sample_info_non_oe <- sample_info[non_oe_samples, ]

dim(counts_non_oe)  # should be 6 samples now (3 DMSO + 3 Reversine, non-OE only)
table(sample_info_non_oe$treatment)
```


```{r}
# --- Run DESeq2 ---
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_non_oe),
  colData = sample_info_non_oe,
  design = ~ treatment
)
 
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
 
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("treatment", "Reversine", "DMSO"))
 
cat("\n=== UBE2H result (Reversine vs DMSO) ===\n")
print(res["UBE2H", ])
```

```{r}
# --- 1. PCA: do samples separate the way we'd expect? ---
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
p_pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("treatment", "LMB2OE")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "GSE188644: sample PCA")
 
print(p_pca)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE188644_PCA.png"), p_pca, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# --- Volcano plot ---
 
volcano_df <- as.data.frame(res)
volcano_df$gene <- rownames(volcano_df)
volcano_df <- volcano_df[!is.na(volcano_df$padj), ]
 
volcano_df$significant <- ifelse(volcano_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(volcano_df$log2FoldChange) >= 1,
                                  "Significant", "Not significant")
 
p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#d64545", "Not significant" = "grey75")) +
  geom_point(data = volcano_df[volcano_df$gene == "UBE2H", ],
             color = "#1f4fd6", size = 3.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = volcano_df[volcano_df$gene == "UBE2H", ],
                   aes(label = gene), color = "#1f4fd6", fontface = "bold",
                   nudge_y = 4, size = 4.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(
    title = "GSE188644: Reversine vs DMSO (non-OE only)",
    subtitle = "RPE-1 p53KO, n = 3 DMSO, n = 3 Reversine",
    x = expression(log[2]*" fold change"),
    y = expression(-log[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
 
print(p_volcano)

ggsave(here("figures", "GSE188644_volcano_UBE2H_nonOE.png"), p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE188644_volcano_UBE2H_nonOE.svg"), p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# --- UBE2H boxplot + points, n=3 per group ---
 
ube2h_counts <- plotCounts(dds, gene = "UBE2H", intgroup = "treatment", returnData = TRUE, normalized = TRUE)
 
p_box <- ggplot(ube2h_counts, aes(x = treatment, y = count, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.8,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.06, seed = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DMSO" = "#4573d6", "Reversine" = "#d64545")) +
  labs(
    title = "UBE2H expression: Reversine vs DMSO",
    subtitle = sprintf("GSE188644, RPE-1 p53KO, non-OE | padj = %.1e", res["UBE2H", "padj"]),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Normalized UBE2H count",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13)
  )
 
print(p_box)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE188644_UBE2H_boxplot_nonOE.png"), p_box, width = 5.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE188644_UBE2H_boxplot_nonOE.svg"), p_box, width = 5.5, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# --- T-test, using DESeq2's normalized counts ---

norm_counts_nonOE <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
ube2h_norm_nonOE <- norm_counts_nonOE["UBE2H", ]

t_test_df_188644 <- data.frame(
  sample = names(ube2h_norm_nonOE),
  ube2h_norm = ube2h_norm_nonOE,
  treatment = sample_info_non_oe[names(ube2h_norm_nonOE), "treatment"]
)
t_test_df_188644$ube2h_log <- log2(t_test_df_188644$ube2h_norm + 1)

t_test_result_188644 <- t.test(ube2h_norm ~ treatment, data = t_test_df_188644)
print(t_test_result_188644)

t_test_log_result_188644 <- t.test(ube2h_log ~ treatment, data = t_test_df_188644)
print(t_test_log_result_188644)
```
